title: Wayland requested geometry differs from mapped window
symptom: Requested 1672x941 and 1280x720 resulted in the same mapped 941x1030 window; target-size benchmark was invalid.
resolution: Capture compositor clients/workspaces/rules and Qt resize events; compare approved floating and tiled test windows before changing geometry logic.
prevention: Native benchmarks must record requested size, actual mapped size, screenshot pixels, scale and compositor state.
